scope: Emmy Noether Paper 19, Idealtheorie in Ringbereichen, tail/source-critical fixes from an earlier RA50 P19 audit checked against the current R259 German cumulative base after WebR252.
result: No TeX patch promoted. The package verifies survival of two previously high-risk P19 tail loci in CurrentR259 and records anti-regression guidance.
checked_loci: printed p58: source-order correction survives; source exponent is e, not rho; CurrentR259 has Q=P, P^e=Q in the checked ideal notation
printed pp65-66: tail index-shift repair survives; CurrentR259 uses s_1...s_lambda, t_1...t_mu, and r_nu=s_1<=...<=s_lambda<=r_nu as supported by the source
source_quality: Best staged paper-level source is GDZ Mathematische Annalen 83 printed pp.24-66 with raw page images reporting 400 ppi. The package includes enlarged labelled crops for pp.58, 65, and 66 because the native source is below the project 650 ppi preference. These are inspection witnesses, not native high-resolution certification.
public_policy: Treat as source-audit/anti-regression support material, not as a reader release.
Do not call this global Paper 19 certification, whole-Noether certification, multilingual synchronization, source closure, or critical-edition material.
Use the package to avoid stale regressions: do not change the p58 exponent from e to rho, and do not revert the p65/p66 tail indices to the older rejected forms.

related_local_not_yet_lane_zipped.scope: Local P17 full-sweep/survival folder with CurrentR259 P17 span, prior ledgers, source PDF, and enlarged witnesses. No matching Noether-lane ZIP was found during this sweep, so it is noted here for follow-up rather than registered as a pending Zenodo upload.
